ShortDescription.Value: Disable hover highlights and UI tooltips without blocking game selection

Publish.LongDescription:
When I played for long hours I start to get distracted from graphical events, such as tooltips when your mouse hover's over icons. Or when a big building gets highlighted, because your mouse drives by. Since I am interested in programming/modding I build a solution.
Maybe in the future I would also like to add the ability to disable some sounds in the game, such as the Hospital Helicopter.
The mod changes visual hover/UI effects only and does not intentionally alter simulation gameplay.
Even though it is very few people that use it, I think it is pretty cool to see someone else use what you build.
The new options panel is located under Options → Modding → DisableHover
Publish.ChangeLog:
Reworked Disable Blue Highlights to use the game rendering systems instead of Harmony/raycast blocking. - Removes the blue building outline and projected 2D hover mesh. - Keeps one-click selection working. - Keeps citizen/object selection pins visible. - Adds separate DH (highlights) and DT (tooltips) toolbar buttons. - Hotkeys were removed.
